description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the AccessFlowStateMachineDao component within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various data access methods related to workflow state machine records, actions, and roles.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating functionality of AccessFlowStateMachineDao in workflow state machine management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForExistingAction
methods.description: Tests retrieving allowed actions for a valid existing action.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForNonExistingAction
methods.description: Tests behavior when querying allowed actions for a non-existent action.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForExistingState
methods.description: Verifies fetching the next state for a valid current state.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForInvalidState
methods.description: Tests fetching next state for an invalid or non-existent current state.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Checks retrieval of actionable states given specific actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Validates saving a new workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion of a specific workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of workflow state machine records for a given workflow.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsNullWorkflow
methods.description: Checks behavior when retrieving records for a non-existing workflow.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowed
methods.description: Tests whether specific actions are permitted based on workflow state and role.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForNonEntry
methods.description: Verifies the permission check for actions on non-allowed states.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsExisting
methods.description: Checks fetching allowed workflow items for existing state/action/role.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsAllStates
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all workflow items when no specific state is given.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsNotExisting
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no matching workflow items exist.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Checks retrieval of specific workflow item by state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Verifies deletion of workflow records associated with a specific role, and ensures other roles remain unaffected.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRoleAllWorkflows
methods.description: Checks deletion of role-specific workflow records across all workflows.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Tests the functionality for renaming roles within workflow records.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemIdsForRole
methods.description: Helper method to fetch workflow item IDs for a given role and workflow.
